current_source_read_scope.integration_constraint: Existing upload services may be tied to the current PC project; remote registration must not silently change that project.

corrections: getType and metadata size do not prove actual file format or bounded bytes.
CATEGORY_OPENABLE deliberately narrows stream access; virtual-document conversion is a separate flow.
Image.open is lazy, and verify does not fully decode; reopen before load.
OWASP image rewriting does not justify overwriting required original source bytes.
Photo receipt, registered photo, selected task, and actual measured geometry are distinct states.
